name: WP Speed Core
changelog:
v1.6.6:
- Zero Rate-Limit GitHub Updater via CDN raw version.json
- Added pre_set_site_transient_update_plugins hook for automatic background update detection
- Added Missing Image Dimensions (Auto Width & Height) to eliminate CLS
- Added Safe Disk HTML Minification with comment stripping
- Added Resource Hints (Preconnect & DNS-Prefetch) in SpeculationEngine
- Added Self-hosted video preload='none' throttling
- Added diagnostic X-WPSC-Cache response headers (HIT/MISS/BYPASS)
